Right: the same runtime makes a real Unitree G1 walk to and push a chair (8/10 trials).

Figure 3:Three ways to couple a slow brain with fast policies.(a) An agent that calls the fast policy puts its latency on every step. (b) A fast policy that calls the agent on errors is interrupted by persistent errors and never by silent failures. (c)REAdispatches from route memory, lets each policy run uninterrupted at native rate, and consults the System 2 judge only when there is a need.
